top_cell.name: comparator
top_cell.note: xschem top-level schematic; netlisted FLAT (no .subckt wrapper) by design/netlist.sh

ports.name: CLK
ports.note: not a bare StrongARM clock port: the DR-003 soft-clock shaper (R_CLKS x M_CLKCAP, tau ~ 250 ps) forms internal node CLKT driving all five clocked gates, so the evaluate onset is slew-limited by that RC rather than by the external ramp rate

ports.name: VINP
ports.note: differential input, true side; Vindiff = VINP - VINN > 0 settles OUTP high

ports.name: OUTP
ports.note: full-swing latch output, true side; precharged to VDD during reset (CLK low)

ports.name: OUTN
ports.note: full-swing latch output, complement side; precharged to VDD during reset (CLK low)
